title: The batch gate files a check flaky when its culprit's revert proves nothing, and verifies the batch
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a landing that fails a core case, whose revert's trial fails a check the base tip fails too, is not reverted; the check is filed as flaky, the tip verifies and the deploy watch serves it, and master status names the flaky item.

steps.name: Gate a batch whose culprit's revert proves nothing through the real loop
